description.value: Granville Island Brewing has been crafting BC beers since 1984 and is one of the province's pioneering craft breweries, with a vibrant public taproom on Granville Island at the heart of Vancouver's seawall cycling network. The taproom pours a rotating small-batch Taproom Series alongside its mainline beers, and serves food on-site with off-sales for those continuing their ride. The patio is dog-friendly and the brewery is wheelchair accessible via a ramp through the side door.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from gib.ca confirms active operation as a public taproom and brewery at 1441 Cartwright Street, Vancouver, with food service and off-sales. The FAQ explicitly confirms off-sales availability and food, and the site shows 2026 event planning confirming the business is open. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms was found anywhere in the website content, so those remain null. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Granville Island Brewery' but the website consistently uses 'Granville Island Brewing'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Granville Island Brewery' but the website consistently uses 'Granville Island Brewing' throughout all pages.
OSM address field contains only 'Vancouver' (no street); website provides full address 1441 Cartwright Street, Vancouver, BC V6H 3R7, which has been used in this record.
OSM has no phone number on file; phone 604-687-2739 taken from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A historic, active craft brewery taproom on Granville Island — one of Vancouver's most popular cycling destinations on the seawall — with food service and off-sales. Clear value for touring cyclists passing through False Creek.
